b_01M12F9W8RF66MDYRE1V6Q4K7V.subject: kitchen_critical_path_driver
b_01M12F9W8RF66MDYRE1V6Q4K7V.content: For kitchen remodels, cabinet lead time (42-56 days for custom cabinets) is the schedule-critical-path driver; demo and the rest of the timeline should be sequenced around the cabinet ship date rather than a fixed start date.
b_01M12F9W8RF66MDYRE1V6Q4K7V.falsification_test: A kitchen job where demo is scheduled without regard to cabinet ship date, or where a non-cabinet trade turns out to be the longer pole, would falsify this.

b_01M12F9W8RWNR37PD84KMT0K08.subject: kitchen_countertop_dead_window
b_01M12F9W8RWNR37PD84KMT0K08.content: Countertop install always trails cabinet install by at least ~14 days (slab lead time from template) because templating cannot happen until cabinets are physically in place — this is a structural dead window in every kitchen remodel schedule, not an exception.
b_01M12F9W8RWNR37PD84KMT0K08.falsification_test: A kitchen job with countertop install occurring within days of cabinet install (no ~14-day gap) would falsify this.
